rationale: Both CR-001 and CR-002 are resolved by targeted, tested fixes. CR-001: _normalize_github_base_url now includes parsed.port in the returned base URL when present (custom_github_api_wrapper.py); three new parametrize cases assert ':8443' and ':8080' inputs round-trip correctly. CR-002: _build_auth_header now uses urlparse on creds.url directly instead of split_git_url — a bare server URL 'https://ghe.company.com' now resolves to the correct GHE base_url; new test asserts this. Fix-up diff is small (~76 lines), test-first, and introduces no new high-risk surface — no scoped confirmation pass required.

business_review.notes: All six construction sites thread base_url.
Backward-compat asserted via 'base_url not in kwargs'.

finding_status.notes: port_suffix appended when parsed.port is truthy; three parametrize cases cover :8443, :8080, and :8443 + /api/v3.
split_git_url + try/except replaced by direct urlparse; new test test_build_auth_header_bare_ghe_url_passes_base_url asserts bare-URL routing.
